description.zh: 了解 KEEP 如何围绕医疗感染控制、个人护理和工业擦拭建立专业擦拭产品体系。
description.en: Learn how KEEP builds wiping systems for infection control, personal care, and industrial environments.

hero.alt: 专业洁净制造与质量控制环境

body.zh: KEEP 将擦拭产品视为关键流程的一部分。我们用稳定材料、场景配方和可追溯供应，把日常清洁动作变成可靠的标准动作。
body.en: KEEP treats wiping products as part of a critical process. Stable materials, scenario-led formulations, and traceable supply turn ordinary cleaning into dependable routine.
